## About
Parts Unlimited is a family-owned and operated auto yard in Pearland, TX. We're a full-service automotive recycling business, and we sell good-quality recycled and new auto parts at competitive prices.
Come out to the yard to see the domestic and foreign parts we stock, or give us a call and we'll tell you what we have. If you've got an old car you're done with, you can sell it to us as well.
We're members of the Texas Automotive Recyclers Association (TARA), the Automotive Recyclers Association (ARA) and United Recycles Group, and we hold ARA Gold Seal Certification. Our neighbors give us 4.4 stars from 123 Google reviews.

## Services
- Recycled Auto Parts: A full range of recycled auto parts, including domestic and foreign parts.
- New Auto Parts: New auto parts, right here at our auto yard in Pearland.
- Sell Your Car at Our Yard: Got an old car sitting around? You can sell it to us at the yard.
- We ship nationwide: Not near Pearland? If the auto parts you need are in stock, we'll ship them within 24 hours.

## FAQ
Q: Do your parts come with a warranty?
A: Yes. All our auto parts are backed by a 90-day warranty. Call us for the details.

Q: How fast can you ship a part?
A: If the part you need is in stock, we'll ship it within 24 hours, and we ship nationwide.

Q: Do you deliver?
A: Yes. Delivery is free in the Greater Houston area.

Q: If I return a part, do I get store credit?
A: We offer refunds instead of store credits.

Q: Can I sell you my old car?
A: Yes. We buy cars at our yard in Pearland. Give us a call to talk it over.
